svg.text: 1. Analysis Class Diagram (Domain Model) — UC11 Ask a question in natural language
WHAT the business is about: conceptual classes in the analyst's vocabulary. No controllers, services, frameworks or persistence.
every class is a noun an energy analyst would recognise -- there is no Controller, Service, Repository or framework type here.
operations are deliberately omitted: analysis answers WHAT the business deals with, design answers HOW software realises it.
DataPoint 1--1 SourceCell: every figure the platform ever shows can be traced back to the exact workbook cell it came from.
Metric is an enumeration of 12 permitted measures; QuerySpecification can only ever refer to one of them.
these concepts reappear in diagram 3 as Pydantic DTOs, AgentState fields and SQLAlchemy entities -- see UC11_analysis_to_design.md.
